_README: root-owned, host state that git cannot hold). One key per project; each entry
declares a scheduled task the project left on a remote host. 'query' is an
optional READ-ONLY listing command (argv, no shell) run verbatim once per
distinct argv; its output is matched per entry ('match' regex, default the
task name) and the verdict joins the artifact: measured / cleared /
unreachable / declared. decommission removes nothing off-box, ever.
Hosts and usernames are deliberately placeholders here: this file is public,
the live /etc copy is where the real host lives (the 2026-10-02 lesson).
